| s0002 | Rebuild, install and restart the daemon | run | bounce-rs | — | — | — | — | — | daemon-runs-head | The running daemon reports the main checkout's HEAD as its commit. | — | — | `just bounce-rs` is the fleet's standing order after every rs merge; this step wraps it unchanged. | — |

_No entries._

<a id="done-when"></a>

## Done when

The daemon runs the merged code from the main checkout, and `just doctor` is clean or names its fixes.

<a id="known-limits"></a>

## Known limits

| id | text |
| --- | --- |
| l-1 | The restart leaves a sub-second gap; clients reconnect. A failure after the old daemon is signalled has no rollback (AGENTS.md, release-build.sh). |
| l-2 | A disruptive rehearsal: run it for real only after a merge, or rehearse at a quiet time (PRD 005 req-24). |

<a id="mistakes"></a>

## Mistakes

| id | text |
| --- | --- |
| m-1 | Bouncing from a linked worktree: it would install that tree's build. |
| m-2 | Building with bare cargo: bounce-rs builds through shared-build at niceness 19, one build at a time. |
